name: Destiny Weaver: world bosses keep their level for a character with scaling on
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1 and DestinyWeaver.Scaling.Offset=3. A world
boss rolls every fight at its authored level (Creature::getLevelForTarget), so a view would show stats its
hit and avoidance tables do not use. Azuregos (6109, rank 3) is placed at level 40 in Elwynn Forest beside a
level-40 Mindless Zombie (1501): with scaling on, a level-60 character sees the zombie lifted to 57 and is
told the world boss's own level 40. view_level is not asked for the boss, because getLevelForTarget answers
a world boss with the viewer's level + 3 whatever is shown; sent_level, the level the client is told, is

steps.label: Scaling on lifts an ordinary creature to 57
Scaling on tells the client a world boss's own level
